title: How I Redesigned My Laravel Blog
content:
<html><head></head><body>Every few years, I feel the pressure to redesign my blog. Design trends change fast, and so does my taste. Once I don't like my site anymore, I cannot let go. I need to work on a new redesign. This article is about the latest redesign of my Laravel blog.
            </body></html>
